question: A 65-year-old man comes to a follow-up appointment with his surgeon 2 months after undergoing hip replacement surgery. His major concern at this visit is that he is still limping since the surgery even after the post-operative pain has subsided. Specifically, when he stands on his right leg, he feels that he has to lean further to the right in order to maintain balance. When standing on his left leg, he feels that he is able to step normally. Damage to which of the following nerves would most likely present with this patient's symptoms?
